label: Genexis FiberTwist XGS2110-2.5G XGS-PON ONT
description: XGS-PON ONT with 1× 2.5GE LAN and no Wi-Fi; one XGS-PON port on SC/APC, 12 Vdc external supply drawing 3.2 W.
notes: Vendor interface specification: 'WAN interface 1x XGS-PON' and 'LAN interface 1x 2.5GE'. Power supply 12 Vdc ± 5%; consumption 3.2 W idle and 3.2 W on (EU-CoC-BBE). No Wi-Fi, no voice port, no CATV. The XGS-PON line rate of 9953 Mbit/s is the ITU-T G.9807.1 convention rather than a vendor figure — the vendor quotes the 2.5 Gbit/s subscriber rate. Connector polish is not published; sc-apc is the XGS-PON subscriber interface this catalogue models.
